newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 23.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories on Jan. 23:
WASHINGTON - Commerce Secretary-designate William Daley vowed to take measures aimed at restoring the Commerce Department's tattered reputation, including abolishing 100 political positions.
NEW YORK - IBM's learnings looked gaudy but the stock fell as investors read between the lines.
WASHINGTON - USAir Group Inc. reported a 120 percent increase in earnings for the year but warned that good times would not continue unless the airline lowered its labor costs.
WASHINGTON - The Washington-based owners of the nation's 16 Palm Restaurants turned down a $70 million offer from a local businessman, saying that the family owned business is not for sale.
